label: A first being that is a component is an alternative to no component being first
note: Same ComponentOf and PriorSimply. The rival requires a distinct whole, so it is strictly stronger than the premise's negation. Model-witnessed alongside the other premises of attributesFromFirst; neither is established and no refutation is recorded. Objection audit 2026-11-12 (attempt b6384b6b-ef1a-405e-8237-0c2127d86b5f): formal alternative; the positions are attested only through Aquinas's report in q.3 a.8, without their reasons.
